limitations: SAMPLE is an ideal pulse source (100 ps edges) that drives both the ADC and the eight CP pins; the chip SAMPLE_CORE pad buffer, its slew and its CK load are not modelled.
Wiring between the ADC outputs and the register, and the CK route, are ideal; the register cells are the foundry cell LPE netlists without top-level extraction.
DVDD is a separate ideal source at the ADC supply value and shares the ideal ground; no supply noise, IR drop or DVDD/VDD offset.
Each Q load is a lumped 150 fF capacitor for the M5/M6 route; the PRUW08SDGZ I-pin input load and route resistance are not modelled.
Deterministic runs at two corners (SS cold, FF hot); no mismatch or noise.
Hold at the ADC outputs (without the delay cell) is scored against the same DFQD1 hold table at the ADC D slew, as if D drove the flop directly.
